screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in Sep 2026 and I am based in Pune, so on-site work is fine.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Agentic AI Engineer role in Pune. I have 3 years of professional software development experience, including building internal AI agents and a CRM at a US-based medical-device company. I use Claude Code daily and work mainly in Python.

Your role centres on production agentic systems with RAG, memory, multi-agent orchestration and guardrails. My multi-agent-research-crew runs planner, researcher, writer and verifier agents on a custom DAG orchestrator with retries, timeouts, token budgets and claim-level citation checking. My site-to-agent project combines hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval (pgvector), cited answers, SSRF-hardened fetching and an eval harness. In PageForge, a deterministic validator flags unsupported numbers before a reviewer signs off.

I am based in Pune, available immediately and comfortable working on-site. I would welcome the chance to walk through these projects, and I will be honest about where I am still growing, such as MCP and cloud deployment. Portfolio: hussain-singapuri.vercel.app.
